svg.title: Azure Files with Microsoft Entra sign-in
svg.desc: testuser1 signs in to the Windows VM. The VM asks Microsoft Entra ID for a Kerberos ticket for the storage account. The VM then mounts the file share over SMB on port 445. The role Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor on the share decides what the user can do. The storage account app is excluded from multifactor authentication policies.
svg.text: The storage app is excluded from MFA
